The model's fresh-tyre offsets are calibrated so that, with its own degradation ladder, it reproduces this net at the stint length it recommends.

regime.derivation: race/practice degradation ratio, stint-fixed-effects estimator on both sessions; residuals pooled with the median: australia-2026 0.75x, barcelona-2026 0.70x, austria-2026 0.58x, belgium-2026 0.32x, hungary-2026 0.64x, italy-2026 0.81x -> management residual 0.67x (spread 0.27 ln); no temperature term (no race-day forecast supplied: no temperature term); the pool gives 0.67x; Suzuka's own practice->race ratio in [2023, 2024, 2025] is 0.58x (+/-0.29 ln), which carries 46% of the precision, so 0.63x applies; the old pooled geometric mean would have given 0.61x. japan-2026's own race is never used
